	int fd = open(important_config, O_WRONLY | O_CREAT, 0600);
	if (fd == -1) {
		perror("open");
		exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
	}

	if (n == -1) {
		perror("read");
		exit(EXIT_FAILURE);
	}
	close(fd);

    // print the important config
	printf("%s\n", buf);

    // remove the important config
	unlink(important_config);

    return 0;
}
